headline: Up Your Arsenal's PAL v1.00 rises from 19.84% to 21.64% of matched code
summary: A sustained run of multiplayer-menu matching made this a busy day for Up Your Arsenal's usually quiet branch. PAL v1.00's matched code rises from 19.84% to 21.64%, with 7,733 of 16,164 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
highlights: The multiplayer-menu work also splits source files where functions need different compiler settings.
A shorter README and grouped documentation replace the long setup guide and hand-maintained progress tables (#16).
Open #17 proposes 31 function matches for Annihilation Nation. It has not merged.
For Clank's Holostar Studios level, open #18 proposes 19 function matches. #19 builds on it with 28 more, and #20 adds another nine. All three remain unmerged.
